failure_disposition.disposition: subject overconstraint; frozen fixture is a valid lean complete_task collaborator

single_cause.effect: The candidate has useful dirty bytes, but completion refuses to snapshot them because callback-supplied metadata is incomplete. All permitted, scope-blocked, parent-blocked, and post-gate cases therefore skip persistence and proof before their intended branch.

why_subject_not_fixture: Preservation is allowed by useful/changed bytes and is not a correctness claim; it does not need pre-existing carrier identity.
The existing snapshot operation followed by the real _candidate_carrier observation establishes the exact metadata needed for proof.
Requiring observed_head_sha/content_digest before that snapshot duplicates an admission check at the wrong lifecycle point and breaks complete_task's injected-collaborator compatibility.

A diagnostic control that supplied the full production _candidate_carrier mapping passed all 7 cases on dbd0a7809, confirming the five failures share this one predicate rather than five independent defects.

misleading_passes.reason: At 0065fea40 both pass before invoking their injected failure. The metadata precondition skips persistence, so neither the refusing git add nor the failing post-persist _candidate_carrier is actually reached.

minimal_repair: For every completed candidate with _candidate_has_work and no already-complete carrier, snapshot first, then call the sole observation owner _candidate_carrier.
Keep proof gated on the fresh carrier being complete commit-only; keep observation failure unknown/ineligible/retained; keep the post-gate same-head/content refresh.
Do not add fields to the frozen harness or add a second carrier schema.
safe_cleanup: The secondary proof_ready blocker is unreachable after carrier_reason has already populated blockers and can be removed.
Updating target_branch from the post-gate _candidate_carrier call is dead when that call receives no branch and can be removed independently.
failure_disposition.recommended_direct_regression: Use a useful incomplete callback candidate without observed_head_sha/content_digest; assert snapshot happens, the gate sees a clean descendant HEAD, and a write after snapshot is caught by the fresh post-gate carrier observation.
failure_disposition.claim_limit: This diagnosis covers the five frozen-acceptance failures and the two false-positive passes at 0065fea40. It does not assess unrelated source complexity, coverage, or the worker timeout.
